O'Connell Center]] |champion= |conf_champ = |conf_champ_result = |tourney= [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2018–19 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Florida Gators men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Florida]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Gators were led by fourth-year head coach [[Mike White (basketball)|Mike White]] and played their home games in the [[O'Connell Center|Exactech Arena at the Stephen C. O'Connell Center]] on the university's [[Gainesville, Florida]] campus as members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished 20–16, 9–9 to finish 8th please. In the SEC Tournament, they defeated [[2018–19 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]], beat [[2018–19 LSU Tigers basketball team|LSU]] in quarterfinals before losing to [[2018–19 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]] in the semifinals. They received a at-large bid to the NCAA Tournament where they defeated [[2018–19 Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball team|Nevada]] in the First Round before losing in the Second Round to [[2018–19 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]]. == Previous season == The [[2017–18 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Gators]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 21–13, 11–7 in [[2017–18 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]] in the First Round before losing in the Second Round to [[2017–18 Texas Tech Red Raiders men's basketball team|Texas Tech]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
